utterance: The way the pain moved to the lower right, your fever, and the tenderness make me concerned about appendicitis—an inflamed appendix. This needs urgent hospital assessment today, not treatment as a stomach bug. I'd also like to check your groin and testicles to rule out other urgent causes of pain. We can have a chaperone present; would that be okay?
reply: I don't want to be in here. I just want to go back to work.

utterance: I understand you want to get back to work, but this could become dangerous if the appendix bursts. You need hospital care now, and I can give you a work certificate. What's worrying you most about going to hospital?

utterance: Getting this checked promptly gives you the best chance of avoiding complications and a longer time off work.
